summary: Aperture AC, a Cayman Islands SPAC trading on Nasdaq, furnished an 8-K with a press release and investor presentation regarding its proposed business combination with Atlantic HPC Group Inc. and a wholly-owned merger subsidiary, AP Ocean Merger Sub. Separately, Atlantic completed the Tennessee Acquisition on September 23, 2026, acquiring 100% of Valley Oasis Development LLC, which holds two power contracts with Dyersburg Electric System for 29 MW of aggregate demand and a one-acre land lease. No deal price, premium, or board recommendation was disclosed in the excerpt; the transaction remains subject to shareholder approval and closing conditions. Watch for the proxy filing, redemption levels, and Atlantic's capitalization details.
